in_english.name: Maajid
in_english.meaning: Glory, magnificence, and sublimity of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Maajid is a name that signifies the glory, magnificence, and sublimity of Allah. Derived from the Arabic root 'm-j-d', it reflects the attributes of Allah and is mentioned in the Quran. The name holds great significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the majesty and dignity of Allah. Individuals bearing this name are considered to embody the qualities of divine glory and sublimity.
